attribution.title: Splendor, Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat 116, Amsterdam: the former municipal bathhouse of 1937, a music venue since 2013
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the roofs, the chimney and the canal and courtyard sides (CC BY 4.0): the street front's black glazed-brick plinth, the bath wing's row of small windows, the gate block with its round-arched grille gate under a Star of David, the green timber bay of the canal-corner house, cream eaves boards under pantile skirts and the two-storey east house with its cornice and dormers. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
